visual_text: Three facts should travel with every catheter
District nurse, GP or continence service
Who will review it or take it out, or try without it, and when
UK district nursing survey, 2017 to 2018: half of the people whose catheter had been placed in the previous 4 weeks had a plan to remove it (134 of 267).
Prieto, J Infect Prev, 2020; Loveday, epic3, J Hosp Infect, 2014
alt_text: Flow from hospital ward to discharge letter to home or care home to district nurse, GP or continence service, with a tag marked written down at discharge listing three facts: why the catheter went in, the date, and who will review or remove it and when. A bar shows 134 of 267 new catheters had a removal plan.
design_instructions: Single card. Vertical flow of four boxes, luggage-style cream tag with three numbered fields joined by dashed line to the discharge letter step, body text and half-bar 134 of 267 hatched (C12-05-e). No people.
